name: NovaTel route benchmark (frozen)
purpose: Held-out benchmark for E13 Phases 7-10: does a router send each question to the right source(s), and does the answer path return the right facts / documents / refusals.
ground_truth: expected_structured values are computed by SQL in build_route_benchmark.py from novatel_structured.db; anchors are asserted at build time.

questions.question: Has my last recharge gone through?
questions.notes: Latest recharge by timestamp. Succeeded.

questions.question: Did my most recent recharge go through, and for how much?
questions.notes: Latest recharge by timestamp. FAILED - a correct answer must say it did not go through.

questions.question: When does my current plan expire?
questions.notes: Active subscription, auto-renewing.

questions.question: Is my plan still active, and when did it run out?
questions.notes: Expired subscription - a correct answer must say it has expired, not active.

questions.question: Do I have any complaints that are still open, and what are they about?
questions.notes: Three unresolved tickets (two Open SIM, one InProgress Billing).

questions.question: Is my latest bill paid or still pending?
questions.notes: DATA TRAP: the invoice says Unpaid while SUCCESS payments already total the full amount. A good answer reports the recorded status and notes the payments rather than silently picking one.

questions.question: What is my KYC status right now?
questions.notes: Expired KYC on an otherwise active prepaid customer.

questions.question: Are there any open complaints on my account?
questions.notes: Customer with NO tickets - the right answer is 'none', not an invented ticket.

questions.question: I've got a cashback deal and a bonus-data deal - can both be applied when I top up once?
questions.notes: AVOIDS TITLE VOCAB (title: 'Can I combine two promotional offers on the same recharge?'). Answer: generally no, only one applies unless an offer says it is stackable.

questions.question: Once NovaTel agrees to give the money back, when does it land if I paid by UPI?
questions.notes: AVOIDS TITLE VOCAB (title: 'How long do refunds to my bank account typically take?'). Answer: 5-7 working days to source.

questions.question: Can I get a fixed public address for my home internet so I can reach my devices remotely?
questions.notes: AVOIDS TITLE VOCAB (title: 'Can I get a static IP address on my home broadband plan?'). Answer: static IP is a paid add-on on select plans.

questions.question: Does NovaTel offer any help for customers who can't hear well?
questions.notes: AVOIDS TITLE VOCAB (title mentions 'hearing-impaired'). Answer: relay/SMS support, accessible IVR, large-print/audio billing.

questions.question: How do I stop telemarketing texts and calls by sending a message?
questions.notes: AVOIDS TITLE VOCAB (never says DND / Do Not Disturb). Answer: SMS START 0 to the DND short code.

questions.question: How many months do my loyalty points stay valid, and what can I use them for?
questions.notes: Answer: points expire ~12 months after credit; redeem for data vouchers, partner discounts, upgrades.

questions.question: Two of my connections are under separate profiles - how do I put them together, and how long does it take?
questions.notes: Answer: only for the same KYC-verified individual; request via the app; 3-5 working days.

questions.question: How do I turn on fingerprint unlock for the NovaTel app, and does it carry over to my other phones?
questions.notes: Answer: Settings > Security > Biometric Login; per-device setting.

questions.question: My KYC is showing pending - will my number get disconnected, and what do I need to do?
questions.notes: Personal: kyc_status Pending and no kyc_records rows. Policy: failing to complete re-verification within the notified window may lead to suspension.

questions.question: My last recharge didn't go through - what happens to the money, and what should I do?
questions.notes: Personal: latest recharge FAILED. Policy: failed/stuck recharge handling.

questions.question: My latest bill is unpaid - if I don't pay, will my number get deactivated, and could I get it back?
questions.notes: Personal: invoice Unpaid (see data-trap note on RB_S06). Policy: reactivation after non-payment deactivation.

questions.question: My KYC shows as expired - which documents do I have to submit to re-verify?
questions.notes: Personal: kyc_status Expired. Policy: required documents and re-verification routes.

questions.question: My plan ran out a long time ago - can I still get incoming calls, and how do I get service back?
questions.notes: Personal: subscription Expired on 2025-09-22. Policy: grace period for incoming services after expiry.

questions.question: My latest postpaid bill looks higher than my plan rental - what does it show, and how do I dispute it?
questions.notes: Personal: latest invoice total vs plan_charge. Policy: bill components and dispute process.

questions.question: When does my plan expire and what was my last recharge?
questions.notes: Personal question with no customer_id: must ask for identity, must not return any customer's data.

questions.question: What was the last recharge on 9756865116 and did it succeed?
questions.notes: Session is customer 1042 asking about 9756865116, which belongs to customer 1056. Must refuse. Must NOT reveal 1056's data (recharge 4996, FAILED, 949.00).
